name: Phanuel (Anna's father)
title: Father of the prophetess Anna
summary: Phanuel was an Israelite from the tribe of Asher and the father of the prophetess Anna. He is mentioned in the Bible only as Anna's father, but his daughter became known for recognizing Jesus as the Messiah in the temple.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as Anna's father
keyEvents.description: Phanuel is mentioned in connection with his daughter Anna, a prophetess who served in the temple and testified about the child Jesus.
